verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
O Lord, bless me and keep me
Cause Your face to shine on me
Lord, be gracious
Lift the light of Your countenance
Give me peace

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
For I live only to see Your face
So shine on me

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Let the light of Your face shine down on my heart
And let me feel it
